text:
jules (eng-platform): heads-up: starting a short planning thread for splitting CI runner pools by region and creating separate GitHub orgs for billing. aim: reduce egress and support regional capacity.

reza (devex): recommend opt-in first: teams update `runs-on` labels to opt into regional pools. less risky.

anya (eng-sre): operational needs: drain/cordon tooling + prometheus gate. example: `runnerctl cordon --pool=apac` then `runnerctl drain --pool=apac --timeout=10m`. gate: `runner_jobs_active == 0`.

tara (eng-security): security tasks: create target org skeletons, rotate GH App installation tokens at cutover, update OIDC audiences, and run a post-move permission audit. legal may require billing signoff for some customers.

mike (infra): infra note: AMIs reference regional endpoints for SSM/metrics. will parameterize AMI build and add per-org IAM role templates. also enforce cost tags in provisioning.

jules (eng-platform): owners: devex=opt-in guide + sed patch; sres=drain playbook + metrics dashboard; security=token rotation plan; infra=AMI/IaC checklist. target share draft in 5 business days.

deploy-bot: webhook-check POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> 200 OK {"ok":true}. supports `X-Hub-Signature-256`.

reza (devex): sample workflow snippet to opt-in:```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, region-apac]
``` will provide migration script.

anya (eng-sre): canary suggestion: 3 low-traffic repos, monitor queue time and tail latency for 48h, expand if healthy. add alert if `job_queue_time` > 2x baseline.

tara (eng-security): blocker: two enterprise accounts need legal/billing signoff. will follow up with GTM.

jules (eng-platform): thanks all. I'll post a kickoff doc link here and book a 30m sync. Drop any blockers here.
